text:
I haven't made the edit, because I can't see the body of `closeFor` (lines 126-143), and a SEARCH block has to match the file text exactly. The outline shows only the signature, not how the function splits a window, whether it changes `windows` in place, or what it adds to the returned number. Writing the change blind could break the "everything else stays as it is" requirement, and a rewrite of the whole file would erase the parts I can't see.

Please paste lines 126-143 of `app/src/tides.ts`, plus line 28 with `LOCKING = 12` including its `const` keyword. Then I'll send one edit that keeps a leftover piece only if it is at least `LOCKING` minutes long. A shorter piece will be dropped and its minutes added to the return value. Windows the closure doesn't touch will stay as they are.
